validator.source_text:
<scxml xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2005/07/scxml" version="1.0" datamodel="ecmascript" initial="s">
  <state id="s">
    <invoke type="echo"/>
    <invoke type="https://stateforward.org/scxml/services/echo" id="svc"/>
    <invoke type="scxml" src="child.scxml"/>
    <transition event="done.invoke.svc" target="f"/>
  </state>
  <final id="f"/>
</scxml>

diagnostics.message: this `<invoke type>` is not an SCXML invoke type or an absolute service type URI

primary.message: not a type any host can bind

notes: an absent `type`, `scxml`, or `http://www.w3.org/TR/scxml/` invokes an SCXML session; any other type names an invoked service by an exact absolute URI (a scheme, `:`, no white space, at most 4096 bytes), which the host binds to a service component
diagnostics.help: write the service's absolute type URI exactly as its service package declares it (`service-uri`), or `scxml` for an SCXML session

diagnostics.message: no service package binds this `<invoke type>`

primary.message: no service component is bound to this URI

notes: an invoked service runs only in the service component its host binds to the exact type URI; without one the session start fails closed, and `compile` rejects the document (`COMP004`)
diagnostics.help: bind the service with its package manifest (`--service-package MANIFEST.json`), or correct the URI to one a bound package declares
